data.about: A truss whose top chord is freeform — two sliders blend a parabola with a sine wave into any shape you like. The bottom tie is then constructed so that every one of its members carries the SAME force: all tie forces are rays of a single circle drawn around the division point of the load line. Whatever shape you choose, the tie re-forms itself and closes exactly on the far support.

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: a 10-panel span between the supports H₃ and I₃ — the dotted verticals are the loads' lines of action
steps.title: The problem

steps.caption: left: F₁ … F₁₀, equal panel loads — right: laid off tip-to-tail down the load line
steps.title: The loads — in both diagrams

steps.caption: equal loads, symmetric span: i is the midpoint of the load line — A = i→D₂, B = Z₂→i on an offset line — left: A and B push up at the supports
steps.title: Reactions and the division point i

steps.caption: left: members 1…11 follow ANY curve — the two sliders blend a parabola with a sine wave; move them! The force diagram will now be built to fit this shape
steps.title: The FREEFORM top chord

steps.caption: right: a circle around i, radius = reaction + tolerance — the tie will be built so every tie force is a RAY of this circle: constant force
steps.title: The design rule: one circle

steps.caption: right: through D₂ ∥ member 1 → K₃ on the circle; through E₂ ∥ member 2 → N₂ — every top-chord force ends on the circle
steps.title: Chords 1 and 2 meet the circle

steps.caption: right: the same parallel through every load-line point ∥ its chord: eleven circle points — left: the chords re-flash
steps.title: … all chords onto the circle

steps.caption: right: ray 22 = K₃→i and web chord 12 = N₂→K₃ — left: their parallels through H₃ and through the first top joint meet at the tie node L₃
steps.title: First tie joint

steps.caption: left: tie members 23…31 ∥ their rays, web members 13…21 ∥ the chords between circle points — right: every tie force has the SAME length: the circle's radius
steps.title: Walk the span

steps.caption: left: from the last tie node ∥ the last ray — it lands EXACTLY on the support I₃: the construction closes — right: ray 32 = J₃→i
steps.title: The closing member 32

steps.caption: blue = compression (the freeform chord), pink = tension (the constant-force tie) — reshape with the sliders: the tie re-forms and still closes; click any joint to inspect it
steps.title: Compression and tension
